title: Every yes is a no
topic: opportunity cost: what every choice quietly costs
hook: Every time you say yes, you are also saying no.
promise: Every choice has a hidden price: the best option you gave up (opportunity cost).

takeaway.text: For your next big yes, name the one thing it says no to.

scenes.narration: Every time you say yes, you are also saying no.
scenes.visualIdea: A single word, YES, fills the frame; its shadow on the wall reads NO.

scenes.narration: You have one evening. If you spend it on the series, it is not spent on the gym, the call or the project.
scenes.visualIdea: An evening drawn as a strip of time; one activity slides in and pushes the others out of the strip.

scenes.narration: Economists call this opportunity cost. The real price of anything is the best thing you gave up for it.
scenes.visualIdea: A price tag hangs on the choice; on the tag is not money but the drawing of what was pushed out.

scenes.narration: We feel the money we spend. We almost never feel the option we lost, because it never shows up on a receipt.
scenes.visualIdea: Two receipts side by side: one shows what you paid, a hidden second receipt slides out from behind it.

scenes.narration: So before your next big yes, ask one question: what is it saying no to?
scenes.visualIdea: The YES and its NO shadow turn to face each other.

claims.text: Opportunity cost is the value of the best alternative given up when making a choice.
